events.title: Contest: Win the chance to design a cosmetic or decorator!
events.summary: The world of the Whims is fading, and they need your help! Rescue Whims, who in turn give you super powers. Then team up with your friends in The Beyond, our timed co-op arena, to reclaim the world's lost Starcane energy. Anyone placing in the Top 20 teams by end of day Sunday, 25 October 2026 (11:59pm GMT/4:59pm Pacific) will be placed in a drawing to win. events.title: Welcome to Whimpact! ✨
events.summary: Hi everyone!We’re thrilled to finally share Whimpact! with the world. The Whims and their vibrant universe are officially here to welcome you on a multi-player journey. We hope you’ll wishlist the game today and follow us for more updates. Over the next few months, we’ll be sharing game updates and peeks behind-the-scenes, as well as ways you can help shape our continued development.
